name: Virgin Money M Account for Business
description: Virgin Money's M Account is a solid all-rounder with no monthly fees and free basic transactions.
verdict: Virgin Money's M Account is a solid all-rounder. No monthly charges and free basic transactions mean it won't quietly eat into your cashflow. You get everything you'd expect from a traditional bank — plus accounting software integration and an online dashboard for your business data, which saves real hours on admin.
features: Track your cashflow and business data with the M-Track dashboard
Earn 0.25% cashback on debit card purchases
Bank online, via app, over the phone or in branch
eligibility: Your business must turn over less than £1 million a year and be based in the UK (excluding Northern Ireland, the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man). You must be at least 18.
welcomePromo: 6-month free trial with Xero accounting software when you open an M Account for Business.
pros: Good for managing your money with the M-Track dashboard
cons: Free account only for companies with annual turnover under £1 million
No branches in the South of England, Wales or Northern Ireland

name: Tide Business Account — Free
description: Tide takes the pain out of managing payments with card readers, payment links and more.
verdict: Tide takes the pain out of managing payments. You can charge customers via card reader, smartphone, payment links or the web — all from one place. If you're registering a new limited company, you can do it through Tide for just £24.99, which is significantly cheaper than Companies House.
features: Connect accounting software from QuickBooks, Sage and Xero
Save over £75 on new limited company registration
Take payments with card readers, payment links, tap to pay and more
Earn interest with a free Instant Saver Account
eligibility: You must be aged 18 or over and have a UK-based business.
welcomePromo: Free bank transfers for 12 months and cashback on eligible purchases.
pros: Cashback and free bank transfers for 12 months
Earn interest with a free savings account
cons: No branches

name: Revolut Basic Business Account
description: Spend in 150+ currencies and manage global payments from one place.
verdict: If your business crosses borders, Revolut carries a lot of useful kit. Spend in over 150 currencies and exchange £1,000 per month at the interbank rate — so you can manage your money, charge customers and send payments across the globe all from one place.
features: Take payments via phone, card reader, web and more
Exchange £1,000 per month at the interbank rate
No-fee international transfers at higher paid tiers
eligibility: Companies should be active and fully incorporated. Your legal home address should be in the UK, EEA, Switzerland, Australia, Singapore or the United States.
welcomePromo: No current welcome promotion for this account.
cons: All accounts have a monthly fee
You cannot deposit cash or cheques
Accounts are not FSCS protected

name: Barclays Business Bank Account
description: Free basic transactions and no monthly fees for the first 12 months.
verdict: Barclays gives you free basic transactions and no monthly fees for the first 12 months, so your money stays where it belongs — in your business. If you're thinking about scaling, account holders can access savings on bookkeeping software, business insurance and more through Barclays's partner marketplace.
features: Save on business purchases from partners including Meta and AWS
Bank online, via app, over the phone or in branch
eligibility: You must be 18 or above and have the right to live in the UK. Open to sole traders, freelancers, limited companies and more.
welcomePromo: Free FreshBooks accounting software for 12 months when you open a Barclays Business account.
pros: Free access to FreshBooks accounting software
Help when you need it, thanks to extensive business support options
cons: Monthly fee of £8.50 after the first year

name: Wallester Business Free Account
description: A fee-free account with 300 virtual cards and real-time expense tracking.
verdict: A fee-free account for managing expenses and issuing virtual debit cards — a genuinely strong alternative to traditional business banking for startups and digital-first teams. If your business needs scalable card and expense management, Wallester is worth a look.
features: Global card use anywhere that accepts Visa
No monthly fees or setup costs
Integrated accounting with QuickBooks, Xero and others
Real-time expense tracking and budget control tools
eligibility: UK, Swiss or EEA-registered businesses can apply.
welcomePromo: No current welcome promotion for this account.
pros: Issue hundreds of business expense cards instantly
Great for international and remote teams
Smart budgeting and expense management tools
cons: No overdraft or business loan options
Mobile app has mixed reviews
Not covered by the FSCS protection scheme

name: WorldFirst Business Account
description: Receive payments in 20+ currencies and send in 100+ with no monthly fee.
verdict: If your business is about to break into new markets, WorldFirst is worth considering. Receive payments in over 20 currencies without charge, and send in over 100. There's no set-up or monthly fee, and there's a potential sign-up bonus on top.
features: Up to 1.2% cashback on card payments
eligibility: You must be 18 or above. Unlike many providers, you don't need a UK address.
welcomePromo: Potential $100 sign-up bonus for new business account holders.
pros: Avoid foreign transaction fees in 15 currencies
cons: No overdraft facility
Some outgoing payments have fees
No FSCS protection

name: NatWest Start Up Business Account
description: No monthly fees and free basic UK transactions for two years — a head start for new businesses.
verdict: NatWest's Startup Business Account gives you no monthly fees and free basic UK transactions for two years. That's a meaningful head start for a new business. You also get branches, a solid mobile app and free accounting software — not bad for nothing.
features: No basic transaction fees for 2 years
Bank online, via app, over the phone or in branch
eligibility: For businesses that have been trading for less than 12 months, with turnover under £1 million, registered in the UK. One person on the application must be a UK resident. You must be 18 or older.
welcomePromo: Free accounting software from FreeAgent included with your account.
pros: Two years of free basic transactions
Manage accounts online, via app, branch, Post Office or phone
cons: No branches in Scotland or Northern Ireland

name: The Co-operative Bank Business Bank Account
description: Fee-free ethical banking with an arranged overdraft of up to £250,000.
verdict: The Co-operative Bank puts its ethics where its money is. A genuinely fee-free account for standard transactions, strong overdraft options, and a long-held commitment to ethical banking make it worth considering if values matter to you as a business owner.
features: No monthly fee and no fee for basic transactions
Integrate accounting software from Sage, Xero and QuickBooks
Access to Clover payment terminals for £1 a month for the first 12 months
Free unlimited access to the Go Get Paid app
Bank online, via app, over the phone or in branch
eligibility: Open to Limited Companies, Sole Traders, Partnerships and Limited Liability Partnerships with up to 10 key individuals. All applicants must be 18 or over and UK residents, with a business address in the UK.
welcomePromo: Access to Clover payment terminals for £1 a month for the first 12 months.
pros: Account management online, by phone, via app or branch
Arranged business overdraft of up to £250,000 (subject to status and eligibility)
cons: No branches in Northern Ireland

name: Monzo Lite Business Account
description: Free business account with same-day opening, instant transfers and 24/7 support.
verdict: Monzo's Lite Account is a free business account with simple ways to pay — including in-person contactless card payments. Around nine in 10 applications are accepted the same day. Once you're in, move money easily with instant UK bank transfers. Digital receipts, transaction insights and 24/7 customer support come as standard.
features: Accept payments via smartphone or payment links
Earn interest on the money in your Instant Access Pots
eligibility: You must be a sole trader or director of a limited company. Open to UK businesses only. T&Cs apply.
welcomePromo: No current welcome promotion for this account.
pros: Same-day account opening for most customers
Great app, with genuinely helpful features
cons: No phone or branch banking
Business accounts not available to charities or partnerships
No accounting software integration with the Lite account

name: Lloyds Bank Business Account
description: UK-wide branch access, no monthly fee for 12 months and 100 free electronic payments.
verdict: If you value banking in branch and face-to-face customer support, Lloyds is a good shout. Branches right across England and Wales, plus Halifax and Bank of Scotland branches if you're in Scotland or Northern Ireland. No monthly fees for 12 months, payment alerts and free debit cards round it out.
transferFee: 100 electronic payments out free per month
features: No account fee for the first year
100 free outgoing electronic payments per month
Custom access levels for other users
Bank online, via app, over the phone or in branch
eligibility: You must be at least 18 years old, a UK resident, and have a UK mobile phone number. Open to sole traders and directors of limited companies with turnover under £25 million a year.
welcomePromo: No current welcome promotion for this account.
cons: £8.50 monthly fee after the first year
Certain transactions have fees
